Verses.VerseAr: الٓر‌ كِتٰبٌ اُحۡكِمَتۡ اٰيٰـتُهٗ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتۡ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡ حَكِيۡمٍ خَبِيۡرٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Alif, Lam, Ra. (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning. This) is (that) Book whose Verses are firmly founded; then they have been explained in detail by (the Lord) Who is All-Wise, All-Aware;

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡاۤ اِلَّا اللّٰهَ‌ ؕ اِنَّنِىۡ لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ نَذِيۡرٌ وَّبَشِيۡرٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That do not worship anyone but Allah. Verily, I am a Warner from Him (Allah) to you and a Bearer of glad tidings;

Words.MeaningEn: and a bearer of glad tidings

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنِ اسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوۡبُوۡاۤ اِلَيۡهِ يُمَتِّعۡكُمۡ مَّتَاعًا حَسَنًا اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَيُؤۡتِ كُلَّ ذِىۡ فَضۡلٍ فَضۡلَهٗ‌ؕ وَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَاِنِّىۡۤ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ كَبِيۡرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that you should seek forgiveness from your Lord, then submit your repentance before Him (with true heart). He will keep you glad and gratified with an excellent provision till an appointed term, and will reward for merit everyone enjoying merit (i.e. will bestow reward and ranks corresponding to one’s amount of righteous deeds and dedicated services). And if you turn away, then I fear for you the torment of a Mighty Day.

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَى اللّٰهِ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ‌ۚ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: You are to return to Allah and He has Mighty Control over everything.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَاۤ اِنَّهُمۡ يَثۡنُوۡنَ صُدُوۡرَهُمۡ لِيَسۡتَخۡفُوۡا مِنۡهُ‌ؕ اَلَا حِيۡنَ يَسۡتَغۡشُوۡنَ ثِيَابَهُمۡۙ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَ‌ۚ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيۡمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Bear in mind! These (disbelievers) fold up their breasts so that they may hide (the state of their hearts) from Him (Allah). Beware! When they cover (their bodies) with their clothes (even then) He knows all those matters which they hide and which they lay open. Surely, He knows best (the secrets of) the hearts.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا عَلَى اللّٰهِ رِزۡقُهَا وَيَعۡلَمُ مُسۡتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسۡتَوۡدَعَهَا‌ؕ كُلٌّ فِىۡ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there is no moving creature (living being) on the earth but (that) its sustenance is (a bountiful obligation) upon Allah. And He knows its resting-place and (also) the place where it is to be entrusted. Everything is (recorded) in the enlightening Book (the Protected Tablet - [al-Lawh al-Mahfuz]).

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ فِىۡ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ وَّكَانَ عَرۡشُهٗ عَلَى الۡمَآءِ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ اَيُّكُمۡ اَحۡسَنُ عَمَلاً‌ ؕ وَلَٮِٕنۡ قُلۡتَ اِنَّكُمۡ مَّبۡعُوۡثُوۡنَ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ الۡمَوۡتِ لَيَـقُوۡلَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡۤا اِنۡ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا سِحۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He (Allah) is the One Who created the heavens and the earth (the higher and the lower strata of the universe) in six days (i.e. six phases or aeons of creation and evolution). And (before the creation of the earth) His Throne of Authority operated on water, (and from that He brought forth all manifestations of life and created you,) so that He might put you to trial to evaluate which of you would prove better conduct-wise. And if you say: ‘You will be raised (brought to life) after death,’ the disbelievers will certainly say: ‘This is nothing (else) but an obvious magic.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَٮِٕنۡ اَخَّرۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ الۡعَذَابَ اِلٰٓى اُمَّةٍ مَّعۡدُوۡدَةٍ لَّيَـقُوۡلُنَّ مَا يَحۡبِسُهٗؕ اَلَا يَوۡمَ يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ لَـيۡسَ مَصۡرُوۡفًا عَنۡهُمۡ وَحَاقَ بِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if We defer their torment for a few fixed days, they will definitely say: ‘What has held it back?’ Beware! The day when that (torment) comes upon them (then) that will not be averted from them, and that (chastisement) will beset them which they used to make fun of.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَٮِٕنۡ اَذَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعۡنٰهَا مِنۡهُ‌ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَيـَـُٔوۡسٌ كَفُوۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if We make man taste Mercy from Us, then withdraw it from him (for some reason), he becomes highly disappointed (and) ungrateful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَٮِٕنۡ اَذَقۡنٰهُ نَـعۡمَآءَ بَعۡدَ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُ لَيَـقُوۡلَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّيِّاٰتُ عَنِّىۡ‌ ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَـفَرِحٌ فَخُوۡرٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And if We make him taste (some) favour after the suffering that afflicted him, then he is sure to say: ‘Gone are all my troubles.’ Surely, he (becomes) most exultant and boastful,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ صَبَرُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِؕ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ لَهُمۡ مَّغۡفِرَةٌ وَّاَجۡرٌ كَبِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except for those who remain steadfast and keep doing pious deeds. For them is forgiveness and great reward.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌۢ بَعۡضَ مَا يُوۡحٰٓى اِلَيۡكَ وَضَآٮِٕقٌۢ بِهٖ صَدۡرُكَ اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلُوۡا لَوۡلَاۤ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ كَنۡزٌ اَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهٗ مَلَكٌ‌ ؕ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنۡتَ نَذِيۡرٌ‌ ؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ وَّكِيۡلٌؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: How may it be that you omit a portion of what has been revealed to you, and that your (sanctified) breast feels straitened (by the idea that) the disbelievers say: ‘Why has any treasure not been sent down to him (the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him]) or why has any angel not come with him?’ (O Glorious Messenger! That is just impossible.) You are but a Warner. (You are neither to tempt someone nor to persecute.) And Allah is a Guardian over everything.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ افۡتَرٰٮهُ‌ؕ قُلۡ فَاۡتُوۡا بِعَشۡرِ سُوَرٍ مِّثۡلِهٖ مُفۡتَرَيٰتٍ وَّادۡعُوۡا مَنِ اسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do the disbelievers say: ‘The Messenger has fabricated this (Qur’an) himself’? Say: ‘Bring then ten forged chapters like this, and call (to your help) whom you can except Allah if you are truthful.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِلَّمۡ يَسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لَـكُمۡ فَاعۡلَمُوۡۤا اَنَّمَاۤ اُنۡزِلَ بِعِلۡمِ اللّٰهِ وَاَنۡ لَّاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ‌ۚ فَهَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Muslims!) So, if they do not accept your challenge, then firmly believe that the Qur’an has been revealed with Allah’s knowledge, and that there is no other God but He. So, will you (now) stick to Islam (firm-footed)?

Verses.VerseAr: مَنۡ كَانَ يُرِيۡدُ الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَا وَزِيۡنَتَهَا نُوَفِّ اِلَيۡهِمۡ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا وَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا لَا يُبۡخَسُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those who lust after the worldly life (only,) with its beauty (and embellishment), We pay them back in full for their works here in this world and their (worldly recompense) is not diminished in the least.

Verses.VerseAr: اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَـيۡسَ لَهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡاٰخِرَةِ اِلَّا النَّارُ‌‌ۖ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوۡا فِيۡهَا وَبٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They are the people for whom there is no (share) in the Hereafter except the Fire (of Hell). And (as for reward in the Hereafter) all (the works) they did in the world have come to nothing, and (all that) they used to do is null and void (because their account is cleared by paying them in full measure in the life of the world, and nothing remains in balance for the Hereafter).

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَمَنۡ كَانَ عَلٰى بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖ وَيَتۡلُوۡهُ شَاهِدٌ مِّنۡهُ وَمِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ كِتٰبُ مُوۡسٰٓى اِمَامًا وَّرَحۡمَةً‌ ؕ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖ‌ؕ وَمَنۡ يَّكۡفُرۡ بِهٖ مِنَ الۡاَحۡزَابِ فَالنَّارُ مَوۡعِدُهٗ‌ۚ فَلَا تَكُ فِىۡ مِرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡهُ‌ اِنَّهُ الۡحَـقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ وَلٰـكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He who holds fast to the Clear Proof from his Lord and a testimony (the Qur’an) too has come from his Lord for his strength and support, and prior to that the Book of Musa ([Moses] the Torah), a guide and mercy (too had come) — so, it is they who believe in it (the Qur’an). Can (he be equal to) the one who denies (the Qur’an) from among (the disbelieving) sects while his abode is the Fire of Hell? So, (O listener!) be not in any doubt about it. Surely, this (Qur’an) is the Truth from your Lord, but most people do not believe.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ افۡتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا‌ؕ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ يُعۡرَضُوۡنَ عَلٰى رَبِّهِمۡ وَيَقُوۡلُ الۡاَشۡهَادُ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَبُوۡا عَلٰى رَبِّهِمۡ‌ۚ اَلَا لَـعۡنَةُ اللّٰهِ عَلَى الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And who can be a greater wrongdoer than the one who fabricates a lie against Allah? Such people will be brought before their Lord and the witnesses will say: ‘These are the ones who foisted a lie upon their Lord.’ Know that Allah’s curse is upon the wrongdoers —

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ يَصُدُّوۡنَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَيَبۡغُوۡنَهَا عِوَجًاؕ وَّهُمۡ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ كٰفِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those who hinder (others) from the path of Allah and look for crookedness in it. And it is they who deny the Hereafter.

Verses.VerseAr: اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ لَمۡ يَكُوۡنُوۡا مُعۡجِزِيۡنَ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ اَوۡلِيَآءَ‌ۘ يُضٰعَفُ لَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ‌ؕ مَا كَانُوۡا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ السَّمۡعَ وَمَا كَانُوۡا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They have no capability at all to frustrate (Allah) on earth, nor are there any helpers for them apart from Allah. The torment will be doubled for them (because) they had neither courage to hear (the Truth) nor vision to see (the Truth).

Verses.VerseAr: اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ الَّذِيۡنَ خَسِرُوۡۤا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It is they who ruined their souls, and the lies they used to invent are (all) gone from them.

Verses.VerseAr: لَا جَرَمَ اَ نَّهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمُ الۡاَخۡسَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This is absolutely true that it is certainly they who will be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَاَخۡبَـتُوۡۤا اِلٰى رَبِّهِمۡۙ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡجَـنَّةِ‌ؕ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Verily those who believe and persist in pious works and humble themselves before their Lord, it is they who are the people of Paradise. They will live there forever.

Verses.VerseAr: مَثَلُ الۡفَرِيۡقَيۡنِ كَالۡاَعۡمٰى وَالۡاٰصَمِّ وَالۡبَـصِيۡرِ وَالسَّمِيۡعِ‌ؕ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيٰنِ مَثَلاً‌ ؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The example of the two parties (the disbelievers and the believers) is like the blind and the deaf (versus) the seeing and the hearing. Are both the cases equal? Will you not take advice (even) then?

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰى قَوۡمِهٖۤ اِنِّىۡ لَـكُمۡ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We sent Nuh (Noah)) to his people. (He said to them:) ‘I am (raised and appointed as) a plain Warner to you,

Verses.VerseAr: اَنۡ لَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡۤا اِلَّا اللّٰهَ‌ؕ اِنِّىۡۤ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ اَلِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That you worship none but Allah. I fear the torment of a grievous day (coming) upon you.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَقَالَ الۡمَلَاُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ مَا نَرٰٮكَ اِلَّا بَشَرًا مِّثۡلَنَا وَمَا نَرٰٮكَ اتَّبَعَكَ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ اَرَاذِلُــنَا بَادِىَ الرَّاۡىِ‌ۚ وَمَا نَرٰى لَـكُمۡ عَلَيۡنَا مِنۡ فَضۡلٍۢ بَلۡ نَظُنُّكُمۡ كٰذِبِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So the disbelieving chiefs and nobles of his people said: ‘You appear to us but a human like ourselves, and we have not seen any (honourable person) following you except the most inferior and lowest of (our society) having superficial opinion (who have become your followers without using discretion). Nor do we find in you any merit and superiority over us (i.e. power and authority, wealth and riches or the worthy people joining your party or for that matter, any such prominent feature). Instead, we consider you to be liars.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَرَءَيۡتُمْ اِنۡ كُنۡتُ عَلٰى بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّىۡ وَاٰتٰٮنِىۡ رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ عِنۡدِهٖ فَعُمِّيَتۡ عَلَيۡكُمۡؕ اَنُلۡزِمُكُمُوۡهَا وَاَنۡـتُمۡ لَـهَا كٰرِهُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Nuh (Noah) said: ‘O my people, what is your view: if I stick to a Clear Proof from my Lord and He has also granted me His (exceptional) Mercy from Himself but that has been veiled from you (like the blind), can we force it upon you coercively while you despise it?

Words.MeaningEn: should We compel you (to accept) it

Verses.VerseAr: وَيٰقَوۡمِ لَاۤ اَسۡــَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مَالاً‌ ؕ اِنۡ اَجۡرِىَ اِلَّا عَلَى اللّٰهِ‌ وَمَاۤ اَنَا بِطَارِدِ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا‌ؕ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّلٰقُوۡا رَبِّهِمۡ وَلٰـكِنِّىۡۤ اَرٰٮكُمۡ قَوۡمًا تَجۡهَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, O my people, I do not (also) demand from you any wealth for (promoting and preaching this message). My reward is only (a bountiful obligation) upon Allah. Nor shall I drive away (for your sake) these (poor and backward) people who have accepted faith. (Do not consider them inferior. It is they who are in fact superior and respectable.) Surely they are those who will be blessed with meeting with their Lord, and truly I find you an ignorant (and insensible) people.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيٰقَوۡمِ مَنۡ يَّـنۡصُرُنِىۡ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ طَرَدتُّهُمۡ‌ؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, O my people, if I drive them away then who will come to my help (to rescue me) from (the wrath of) Allah? Do you not reflect?

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَاۤ اَقُوۡلُ لَـكُمۡ عِنۡدِىۡ خَزَآٮِٕنُ اللّٰهِ وَلَاۤ اَعۡلَمُ الۡغَيۡبَ وَلَاۤ اَقُوۡلُ اِنِّىۡ مَلَكٌ وَّلَاۤ اَقُوۡلُ لِلَّذِيۡنَ تَزۡدَرِىۡۤ اَعۡيُنُكُمۡ لَنۡ يُّؤۡتِيَهُمُ اللّٰهُ خَيۡرًا‌ؕ اَللّٰهُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا فِىۡۤ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ‌ ۖۚ اِنِّىۡۤ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And I do not say (this) to you: I have treasures of Allah (i.e. I am a very rich person); nor do I know of the unseen on my own (without Allah’s Revelation). Nor do I say: I am an angel (not a man. My message is not based on charismatic claims). Nor do I say pertaining to those who are inferior in your eyes: Allah will not award them any good at all (that is Allah’s command and everyone’s share). Allah knows best what is in their hearts. (If I were to say that,) surely I shall be among the wrongdoers the same moment.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا يٰنُوۡحُ قَدۡ جَادَلۡتَـنَا فَاَكۡثَرۡتَ جِدَالـنَا فَاۡتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَاۤ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘O Nuh (Noah), indeed you have disputed with us and disputed much. So now bring upon us that (torment) which you promise us if you are (really) truthful.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اِنَّمَا يَاۡتِيۡكُمۡ بِهِ اللّٰهُ اِنۡ شَآءَ وَمَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ بِمُعۡجِزِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Nuh (Noah) said: ‘Allah alone will bring upon you that (torment) if He so wills and you cannot hinder (Him).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا يَنۡفَعُكُمۡ نُصۡحِىۡۤ اِنۡ اَرَدْتُّ اَنۡ اَنۡصَحَ لَكُمۡ اِنۡ كَانَ اللّٰهُ يُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يُّغۡوِيَكُمۡ‌ؕ هُوَ رَبُّكُمۡ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And even if I resolve to counsel you, my counsel (too) will not benefit you if Allah wills to lead you astray. He is your Lord and you will be returned to Him alone.’

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ افۡتَرٰٮهُ‌ؕ قُلۡ اِنِ افۡتَرَيۡتُهٗ فَعَلَىَّ اِجۡرَامِىۡ وَاَنَا بَرِىۡٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُجۡرِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Glorious Messenger!) Do they say: ‘The Messenger has fabricated this (Qur’an) himself’? Say: ‘If I have fabricated it, then I shall have to bear (the resulting torment of) my sin. And I am free of the sin that you are perpetrating.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاُوۡحِىَ اِلٰى نُوۡحٍ اَنَّهٗ لَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنَ مِنۡ قَوۡمِكَ اِلَّا مَنۡ قَدۡ اٰمَنَ فَلَا تَبۡتَٮِٕسۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ‌ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And it was revealed to Nuh (Noah): ‘None of your people will (now) believe (any more) except those who have (so far) believed. So you should not grieve over their (belying and mocking) activities.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاصۡنَعِ الۡفُلۡكَ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا وَلَا تُخَاطِبۡنِىۡ فِىۡ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا‌ؕ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّغۡرَقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And build an Ark before Our Eyes in compliance with Our instructions, and do not converse with Me (about anything) pertaining to the wrongdoers. They will surely be drowned.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَصۡنَعُ الۡفُلۡكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيۡهِ مَلَاٌ مِّنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ سَخِرُوۡا مِنۡهُ‌ؕ قَالَ اِنۡ تَسۡخَرُوۡا مِنَّا فَاِنَّا نَسۡخَرُ مِنۡكُمۡ كَمَا تَسۡخَرُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Nuh (Noah) set himself to building the Ark. And whenever the chiefs of his people passed by him, they would scoff at him. Nuh (Noah) would say (in reply): ‘If you are mocking us (today), we shall also mock you (tomorrow) as you are mocking us.

Verses.VerseAr: فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ مَنۡ يَّاۡتِيۡهِ عَذَابٌ يُّخۡزِيۡهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So you will soon learn upon whom comes (in this very world the torment) that will disgrace and humiliate him and (then whom) the torment that will last forever befalls (in the Hereafter too).’

Verses.VerseAr: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّوۡرُ قُلۡنَا احۡمِلۡ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلٍّ زَوۡجَيۡنِ اثۡنَيۡنِ وَاَهۡلَكَ اِلَّا مَنۡ سَبَقَ عَلَيۡهِ الۡقَوۡلُ وَمَنۡ اٰمَنَ‌ؕ وَمَاۤ اٰمَنَ مَعَهٗۤ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Until when Our Command (of torment) came and the oven started gushing (like fountains, then) We said: ‘(O Nuh [Noah],) get aboard the Ark a pair of animals (male and female) of every species and (take in) your family also except those against whom the Command (of destruction) has already gone forth, and whoever has believed (take him also with you).’ And, except a few, none had believed with him.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ ارۡكَبُوۡا فِيۡهَا بِسۡمِ اللّٰهِ مَجْرٖؔٮھَا وَمُرۡسٰٮهَا ‌ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّىۡ لَـغَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
Verses.VerseEn: Nuh (Noah) said: ‘Get into the Ark; in the Name of Allah will it sail and anchor. Surely my Lord is Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَهِىَ تَجۡرِىۡ بِهِمۡ فِىۡ مَوۡجٍ كَالۡجِبَالِ وَنَادٰى نُوۡحُ اۨبۡنَهٗ وَكَانَ فِىۡ مَعۡزِلٍ يّٰبُنَىَّ ارۡكَبْ مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُنۡ مَّعَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the Ark kept sailing, carrying them through (violent) waves towering like mountains. Then Nuh (Noah) called out to his son, who had separated from him (and was standing with the disbelievers): ‘O my son, get aboard with us and do not stay with the disbelievers.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ سَاَاوِىۡۤ اِلٰى جَبَلٍ يَّعۡصِمُنِىۡ مِنَ الۡمَآءِ‌ؕ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الۡيَوۡمَ مِنۡ اَمۡرِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا مَنۡ رَّحِمَ‌ۚ وَحَالَ بَيۡنَهُمَا الۡمَوۡجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الۡمُغۡرَقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He said: ‘(Instead of embarking on the Ark) I shall just now take shelter on some mountain. That will save me from the Deluge.’ Nuh (Noah) said: ‘None can save today from Allah’s punishment except someone to whom He (Allah) shows His Mercy.’ In the meanwhile, a (violent) wave came between both (father and son). So he was one of the drowned.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقِيۡلَ يٰۤاَرۡضُ ابۡلَعِىۡ مَآءَكِ وَيٰسَمَآءُ اَقۡلِعِىۡ وَغِيۡضَ الۡمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ الۡاَمۡرُ وَاسۡتَوَتۡ عَلَى الۡجُوۡدِىِّ‌ وَقِيۡلَ بُعۡدًا لِّـلۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (And when all were drowned and annihilated except Nuh’s [Noah’s] Ark) it was commanded: ‘O earth, swallow up your water and, O sky, cease pouring.’ And the water was dried and the Command was executed and the Ark came to rest on Mount al-Judi and it was said: ‘Far away are the unjust (from Mercy)!’

Verses.VerseAr: وَنَادٰى نُوۡحٌ رَّبَّهٗ فَقَالَ رَبِّ اِنَّ ابۡنِىۡ مِنۡ اَهۡلِىۡ وَاِنَّ وَعۡدَكَ الۡحَـقُّ وَاَنۡتَ اَحۡكَمُ الۡحٰكِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Nuh (Noah) called out to his Lord and submitted: ‘O my Lord, indeed my son (too) was a part of my family and certainly Your promise is true, and You are the Greatest of all rulers.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ يٰـنُوۡحُ اِنَّهٗ لَـيۡسَ مِنۡ اَهۡلِكَ‌ ‌ۚاِنَّهٗ عَمَلٌ غَيۡرُ صٰلِحٍ‌‌ۖ فَلَا تَسۡــَٔلۡنِ مَا لَـيۡسَ لَـكَ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌ‌ؕ اِنِّىۡۤ اَعِظُكَ اَنۡ تَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡجٰهِلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Allah) said: ‘O Nuh (Noah), indeed he is not included in your family because his actions were not righteous. So do not ask Me a question (about matters) of which you have no knowledge. I admonish you lest you should become amongst the unwise.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّىۡۤ اَعُوۡذُ بِكَ اَنۡ اَسۡــَٔلَكَ مَا لَـيۡسَ لِىۡ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌ‌ؕ وَاِلَّا تَغۡفِرۡ لِىۡ وَتَرۡحَمۡنِىۡۤ اَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Nuh (Noah) submitted: ‘O my Lord, I seek refuge with You from asking You that of which I have no knowledge. And if You forgive me not and bestow (not) mercy on me (then) I shall be of the losers.’

Words.MeaningEn: and You have mercy on me

Verses.VerseAr: قِيۡلَ يٰـنُوۡحُ اهۡبِطۡ بِسَلٰمٍ مِّنَّا وَبَرَكٰتٍ عَلَيۡكَ وَعَلٰٓى اُمَمٍ مِّمَّنۡ مَّعَكَ‌ؕ وَاُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمۡ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُمۡ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He was commanded: ‘O Nuh (Noah), get down (from the Ark) with peace and blessings from Us on you and on the (kingdoms, classes and) species that are with you. And there will (also) be (classes and) species (in future again) whom We shall provide with (the worldly favours); then a painful torment will come upon them from Us.’

Verses.VerseAr: تِلۡكَ مِنۡ اَنۡۢبَآءِ الۡغَيۡبِ نُوۡحِيۡهَاۤ اِلَيۡكَ‌ۚ مَا كُنۡتَ تَعۡلَمُهَاۤ اَنۡتَ وَلَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ هٰذَا‌ ‌ۛؕ فَاصۡبِرۡ‌ ‌ۛؕ اِنَّ الۡعَاقِبَةَ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This (narration) is of the accounts of the unseen that We reveal to you. Neither you nor your people knew them before this. So observe patience. Surely it is the Godfearing with whom it ends well.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِلٰى عَادٍ اَخَاهُمۡ هُوۡدًا‌ؕ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوۡا اللّٰهَ مَا لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗ‌ؕ اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا مُفۡتَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And to the people of ‘Ad (We sent) their (kinship) brother Hud. He said: ‘O my people, worship Allah. You have no God other than Him. You merely invent a lie against Allah (of having a partner).

Verses.VerseAr: يٰقَوۡمِ لَاۤ اَسۡــَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ اَجۡرًا‌ؕ اِنۡ اَجۡرِىَ اِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِىۡ فَطَرَنِىۡ ؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O my people! I do not demand of you any recompense for this (promotion and preaching of the message). My reward is (a bountiful obligation) upon Him Who has created me. Do you not apply your mind?

Verses.VerseAr: وَيٰقَوۡمِ اسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوۡبُوۡۤا اِلَيۡهِ يُرۡسِلِ السَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّدۡرَارًا وَّيَزِدۡكُمۡ قُوَّةً اِلٰى قُوَّتِكُمۡ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوۡا مُجۡرِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, O people, seek forgiveness of your Lord (for your sins), then turn towards Him (with true hearts). He will send upon you copious downpour from the sky and will add strength to your strength. So, do not turn away from Him becoming sinners.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا يٰهُوۡدُ مَا جِئۡتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَّمَا نَحۡنُ بِتَارِكِىۡۤ اٰلِهَـتِنَا عَنۡ قَوۡلِكَ وَمَا نَحۡنُ لَـكَ بِمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘O Hud, you have not brought us any clear proof. Nor are we going to forsake our gods at your behest and nor are we to believe in you.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ نَّقُوۡلُ اِلَّا اعۡتَرٰٮكَ بَعۡضُ اٰلِهَتِنَا بِسُوۡٓءٍ‌ؕ قَالَ اِنِّىۡۤ اُشۡهِدُ اللّٰهَ وَاشۡهَدُوۡۤا اَنِّىۡ بَرِىۡٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: We can say nothing except that some of our gods have afflicted you with (mental) disorder.’ Hud said: ‘Indeed I call Allah to witness, and you too bear witness that I have no concern with those whom you associate as partners with Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ‌ فَكِيۡدُوۡنِىۡ جَمِيۡعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنۡظِرُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except for Him (Allah), join in to hatch (some) plot against me all of you (including your false gods), then grant me no respite (as well).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنِّىۡ تَوَكَّلۡتُ عَلَى اللّٰهِ رَبِّىۡ وَرَبِّكُمۡ‌ؕ مَا مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍ اِلَّا هُوَ اٰخِذٌۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَاؕ اِنَّ رَبِّىۡ عَلٰى صِرٰطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely I have put my trust in Allah Who is my Lord (as well as) your Lord. And there is not a moving (living) creature but He holds it by its forelock (i.e. is completely in the grip of His Mighty Control). Surely my Lord is (found by treading) the straight road (of truth and justice).

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَقَدۡ اَبۡلَغۡتُكُمۡ مَّاۤ اُرۡسِلۡتُ بِهٖۤ اِلَيۡكُمۡ‌ؕ وَيَسۡتَخۡلِفُ رَبِّىۡ قَوۡمًا غَيۡرَكُمۡۚ وَلَا تَضُرُّوۡنَهٗ شَيْئًا ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّىۡ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ حَفِيۡظٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: If even then you turn away then I have literally brought you (all those Commandments) with which I have been sent to you. And my Lord will appoint some other people in your place as your successors, and you can do Him no harm at all. Surely my Lord is Protector of everything.’

Words.MeaningEn: And my Lord will give succession
And my Lord will give succession

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا نَجَّيۡنَا هُوۡدًا وَّالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مَعَهٗ بِرَحۡمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَنَجَّيۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ غَلِيۡظٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when Our Command (of torment) came to pass (then) We saved Hud and the believers with him because of Our Mercy, and We delivered them from severe punishment.

Verses.VerseAr: وَتِلۡكَ عَادٌ‌ۙ جَحَدُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَعَصَوۡا رُسُلَهٗ وَاتَّبَعُوۡۤا اَمۡرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيۡدٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And these are (the people of) ‘Ad who denied the Revelations of their Lord and disobeyed their Messengers and followed the dictates of every oppressive (and arrogant) enemy of the Truth.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاُتۡبِعُوۡا فِىۡ هٰذِهِ الدُّنۡيَا لَعۡنَةً وَّيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ‌ؕ اَلَاۤ اِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوۡا رَبَّهُمۡ‌ؕ اَلَا بُعۡدًا لِّعَادٍ قَوۡمِ هُوۡدٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: A curse was set to chase them in this world, and (will chase them) on the Day of Resurrection (as well). Bear in mind that (the people of) ‘Ad denied their Lord. Beware! Far away (from Mercy) are the ‘Ad, the people of Hud!

Verses.VerseAr: ‌وَاِلٰى ثَمُوۡدَ اَخَاهُمۡ صٰلِحًا‌ۘ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوۡا اللّٰهَ مَا لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗ‌ؕ هُوَ اَنۡشَاَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ وَاسۡتَعۡمَرَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَاسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡهُ ثُمَّ تُوۡبُوۡۤا اِلَيۡهِ‌ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّىۡ قَرِيۡبٌ مُّجِيۡبٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (We sent) to (the people of) Thamud their (kinship) brother Salih. He said: ‘O my people, worship Allah. You have no God apart from Him. He is the One Who raised you up from the earth and settled you therein. So, beg His forgiveness and then turn to Him in repentance. Surely my Lord is Near, Granting prayers.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا يٰصٰلِحُ قَدۡ كُنۡتَ فِيۡنَا مَرۡجُوًّا قَبۡلَ هٰذَآ‌ اَتَـنۡهٰٮنَاۤ اَنۡ نَّـعۡبُدَ مَا يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَا وَاِنَّنَا لَفِىۡ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُوۡنَاۤ اِلَيۡهِ مُرِيۡبٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘O Salih, only you have been the centre of hopes among our people before this. Are you forbidding us to worship those (idols) which our forefathers used to worship? We are really caught in a disquieting doubt about (the Oneness of Allah) towards which you are calling us.’

Words.MeaningEn: the one in whom hope was placed

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُ عَلٰى بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّىۡ وَاٰتٰٮنِىۡ مِنۡهُ رَحۡمَةً فَمَنۡ يَّـنۡصُرُنِىۡ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ عَصَيۡتُهٗ‌ فَمَا تَزِيۡدُوۡنَنِىۡ غَيۡرَ تَخۡسِيۡرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Salih said: ‘O my people, just think if I cling to the clear proof from my Lord, and I have been blessed with a (special) Mercy from Him (then after that) if I disobey Him (by holding back His Commandments from you), then who can help me escape from (the torment of) Allah? So, you can add to me nothing except inflicting loss.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيٰقَوۡمِ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةُ اللّٰهِ لَـكُمۡ اٰيَةً فَذَرُوۡهَا تَاۡكُلۡ فِىۡۤ اَرۡضِ اللّٰهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوۡهَا بِسُوۡٓءٍ فَيَاۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابٌ قَرِيۡبٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, O my people, this is a (peculiarly created) she-camel of Allah (which) is a Sign for you. So leave her free to graze in Allah’s earth and do her no harm lest an imminent torment should seize you.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَعَقَرُوۡهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوۡا فِىۡ دَارِكُمۡ ثَلٰثَةَ اَيَّامٍ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ وَعۡدٌ غَيۡرُ مَكۡذُوۡبٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then they (hamstrung and) slaughtered her. Salih said: ‘(Now) you luxuriate in your abodes (only) for three days. This is a promise which will (never) become untrue.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا نَجَّيۡنَا صٰلِحًـا وَّالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مَعَهٗ بِرَحۡمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَمِنۡ خِزۡىِ يَوۡمِٮِٕذٍ‌ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الۡقَوِىُّ الۡعَزِيۡزُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then, when Our Command (of torment) came to pass, We saved Salih and the believers with him through Our Mercy and (also delivered them) from the humiliation of that day. Surely your Lord alone is Powerful, Sovereign.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَخَذَ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا الصَّيۡحَةُ فَاَصۡبَحُوۡا فِىۡ دِيَارِهِمۡ جٰثِمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And a dreadful Blast overtook the wrongdoers. So morning found them (dead) lying prone in their homes,

Verses.VerseAr: كَاَنۡ لَّمۡ يَغۡنَوۡا فِيۡهَا‌ؕ اَلَاۤ اِنَّ ثَمُوۡدَا۟ كَفَرُوۡا رَبَّهُمۡ‌ؕ اَلَا بُعۡدًا لِّـثَمُوۡدَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: As if they had never dwelled there. Remember! (The people of) Thamud denied their Lord. Beware! Far away (from Mercy) are (the people of) Thamud.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَاۤ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ بِالۡبُشۡرٰى قَالُوۡا سَلٰمًا‌ؕ قَالَ سَلٰمٌ‌ فَمَا لَبِثَ اَنۡ جَآءَ بِعِجۡلٍ حَنِيۡذٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed Our deputed angels came to Ibrahim (Abraham) bearing glad tidings. They greeted him, saying: ‘Peace (be on you),’ and Ibrahim (Abraham) reciprocated: ‘Peace (be on you).’ Then he did not take any time and brought (them) a roasted calf (in hospitality).

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا رَاٰۤ اَيۡدِيَهُمۡ لَا تَصِلُ اِلَيۡهِ نَكِرَهُمۡ وَاَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيۡفَةً‌ ؕ قَالُوۡا لَا تَخَفۡ اِنَّاۤ اُرۡسِلۡنَاۤ اِلٰى قَوۡمِ لُوۡطٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then, when (Ibrahim [Abraham]) saw that their hands did not stretch towards that (dish), he took them as strangers and felt a little fear of them in (his) heart. They said: ‘Do not be afraid. We have been sent to the people of Lut (Lot).’

Verses.VerseAr: وَامۡرَاَتُهٗ قَآٮِٕمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتۡ فَبَشَّرۡنٰهَا بِاِسۡحٰقَۙ وَمِنۡ وَّرَآءِ اِسۡحٰقَ يَعۡقُوۡبَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And his wife (Sara) who was standing (beside) laughed. So We conveyed to his (wife) the glad tidings of the birth of Ishaq (Isaac) and beyond Ishaq of Ya‘qub (Jacob).

Words.MeaningEn: Then We gave her glad tidings

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَتۡ يٰوَيۡلَتٰٓى ءَاَلِدُ وَاَنَا عَجُوۡزٌ وَّهٰذَا بَعۡلِىۡ شَيۡخًا‌ؕ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَىۡءٌ عَجِيۡبٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: She said: ‘Amazing! Shall I bear a child while I have grown old and my husband (too) is an old man? It is extremely astonishing indeed!’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡۤا اَتَعۡجَبِيۡنَ مِنۡ اَمۡرِ اللّٰهِ‌ رَحۡمَتُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكٰتُهٗ عَلَيۡكُمۡ اَهۡلَ الۡبَيۡتِ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ حَمِيۡدٌ مَّجِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The angels said: ‘Are you wondering at Allah’s Command? O people of the house, (showered) upon you are Mercy and Blessings of Allah. Indeed He (is) Praiseworthy, Glorious.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنۡ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ الرَّوۡعُ وَجَآءَتۡهُ الۡبُشۡرٰى يُجَادِلُــنَا فِىۡ قَوۡمِ لُوۡطٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So when fear disappeared from Ibrahim (Abraham) and the glad tidings reached him, he disputed (with) Our (angels) about the people of Lut (Lot).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ لَحَـلِيۡمٌ اَوَّاهٌ مُّنِيۡبٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Assuredly Ibrahim (Abraham) was indeed most forbearing, sobbing and submissive and turning to Us under all circumstances.

Verses.VerseAr: يٰۤاِبۡرٰهِيۡمُ اَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡ هٰذَاۚ اِنَّهٗ قَدۡ جَآءَ اَمۡرُ رَبِّكَ‌ۚ وَاِنَّهُمۡ اٰتِيۡهِمۡ عَذَابٌ غَيۡرُ مَرۡدُوۡدٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The angels said:) ‘O Ibrahim (Abraham), leave off this (matter). Surely the Command of (torment from) your Lord has now come to pass, and the torment is about to seize them which cannot be averted.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُـنَا لُوۡطًا سِىۡٓءَ بِهِمۡ وَضَاقَ بِهِمۡ ذَرۡعًا وَّقَالَ هٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَصِيۡبٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when Our deputed angels visited Lut (Lot), he felt worried on their arrival and on account of them his strength sank and he said: ‘This is a day of great distress.’ (The angels were extremely handsome, and Lut (Lot) was aware of the evil habit of his people. So he was perturbed at the fear of possible mischief.)

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَآءَهٗ قَوۡمُهٗ يُهۡرَعُوۡنَ اِلَيۡهِؕ وَمِنۡ قَبۡلُ كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ السَّيِّاٰتِ‌ؕ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىۡ هُنَّ اَطۡهَرُ لَـكُمۡ‌ۚ فَاتَّقُوۡا اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُوۡنِ فِىۡ ضَيۡفِىۡؕ اَلَيۡسَ مِنۡكُمۡ رَجُلٌ رَّشِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (So the same happened that he apprehended.) The people of Lut (Lot, hearing about the arrival of the guests,) came to him running. And they were already addicted to evil-doing. Lut (Lot) said: ‘O my (disobedient) people, here are my (people’s) daughters. They are pure and lawful for you (through marriage). So, fear Allah and do not humiliate me before my guests (because of your indecency). Is there not among you even a single man of upright character?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَ مَا لَـنَا فِىۡ بَنٰتِكَ مِنۡ حَقٍّ‌ۚ وَّاِنَّكَ لَـتَعۡلَمُ مَا نُرِيۡدُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘You know it well that we have nothing to do with your (people’s) daughters. And you certainly know what we desire.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ لَوۡ اَنَّ لِىۡ بِكُمۡ قُوَّةً اَوۡ اٰوِىۡۤ اِلٰى رُكۡنٍ شَدِيۡدٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Lut (Lot) said: ‘Would that I had the power to resist you or I could seek shelter (today) in some indomitable fort.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا يٰلُوۡطُ اِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَنۡ يَّصِلُوۡۤا اِلَيۡكَ‌ فَاَسۡرِ بِاَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعٍ مِّنَ الَّيۡلِ وَلَا يَلۡتَفِتۡ مِنۡكُمۡ اَحَدٌ اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَكَ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ مُصِيۡبُهَا مَاۤ اَصَابَهُمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّ مَوۡعِدَهُمُ الصُّبۡحُ‌ؕ اَلَيۡسَ الصُّبۡحُ بِقَرِيۡبٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Thereupon the angels) said: ‘O Lut (Lot), we are the messengers of your Lord. These people shall never be able to get at you. So leave in a part of the night with your family and let not any of you look (back); but (do not take) your wife (with you). The same (torment) which will come upon them is going to reach her (too). Surely, the time appointed for their (torment) is the morning. And is the morning not near?’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا جَعَلۡنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا حِجَارَةً مِّنۡ سِجِّيۡلٍۙ  مَّنۡضُوۡدٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then, when Our command (of chastisement) came to pass, We turned the town upside down and We rained upon it stones and pebbles of baked clay which incessantly teemed down (layer upon layer),

Verses.VerseAr: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ‌ؕ وَمَا هِىَ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ بِبَعِيۡدٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Which were marked by your Lord. And this (torment of stones) is not far away from the wrongdoers (even now).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِلٰى مَدۡيَنَ اَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبًا‌ؕ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوۡا اللّٰهَ مَا لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗ‌ؕ وَلَا تَـنۡقُصُوۡا الۡمِكۡيَالَ وَالۡمِيۡزَانَ‌ اِنِّىۡۤ اَرٰٮكُمۡ بِخَيۡرٍ وَّاِنِّىۡۤ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ مُّحِيۡطٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We (sent) to (the people of) Madyan their (kinship) brother Shu‘aib. He said: ‘O my people, worship Allah. You have no God but He. And do not give short measure and weight. Indeed I see you prosperous, but I fear for you the torment of a day which is about to encompass (you).

Verses.VerseAr: وَيٰقَوۡمِ اَوۡفُوۡا الۡمِكۡيَالَ وَالۡمِيۡزَانَ بِالۡقِسۡطِ‌ وَلَا تَبۡخَسُوۡا النَّاسَ اَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, O my people, give full measure and full weight with justice, and do not give people their things less than their due. And do not spread destruction in the land by becoming mischief-mongers.

Verses.VerseAr: بَقِيَّتُ اللّٰهِ خَيۡرٌ لَّـكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‌  ۚ وَمَاۤ اَنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ بِحَفِيۡظٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That which is left over from Allah’s provision (only that) is better for you if you have faith. And I am not a guardian over you.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا يٰشُعَيۡبُ اَصَلٰوتُكَ تَاۡمُرُكَ اَنۡ نَّتۡرُكَ مَا يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَاۤ اَوۡ اَنۡ نَّـفۡعَلَ فِىۡۤ اَمۡوٰلِنَا مَا نَشٰٓؤُا‌ؕ اِنَّكَ لَاَنۡتَ الۡحَـلِيۡمُ الرَّشِيۡدُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘O Shu‘aib, does your Prayer only command you that we forsake those (gods) which our fathers have been worshipping, or that we refrain from doing with our wealth what we like? Surely you (alone) must be the most tolerant and guided one!’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُ عَلٰى بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّىۡ وَرَزَقَنِىۡ مِنۡهُ رِزۡقًا حَسَنًا‌ؕ وَمَاۤ اُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ اُخَالِفَكُمۡ اِلٰى مَاۤ اَنۡهٰٮكُمۡ عَنۡهُ‌ؕ اِنۡ اُرِيۡدُ اِلَّا الۡاِصۡلَاحَ مَا اسۡتَطَعۡتُ‌ؕ وَمَا تَوۡفِيۡقِىۡۤ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ‌ؕ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَاِلَيۡهِ اُنِيۡبُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Shu‘aib said: ‘O my people, tell me if I adhere to the clear proof from my Lord and He has also granted me pure and fine means of living from His Presence, (then why should I not preach the Truth)? I (also) do not want that, following you, I myself start doing (against the Truth) the same that I am forbidding you. All I desire is to (reform) you as far as I can, and my capability comes only from Allah’s (help). So I have put my trust in Him alone and I turn towards Him alone.

Words.MeaningEn: as much as I am able

Verses.VerseAr: وَيٰقَوۡمِ لَا يَجۡرِمَنَّكُمۡ شِقَاقِىۡۤ اَنۡ يُّصِيۡبَكُمۡ مِّثۡلُ مَاۤ اَصَابَ قَوۡمَ نُوۡحٍ اَوۡ قَوۡمَ هُوۡدٍ اَوۡ قَوۡمَ صٰلِحٍ‌ؕ وَمَا قَوۡمُ لُوۡطٍ مِّنۡكُمۡ بِبَعِيۡدٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, O my people, let not your enmity and hostility against me so incite you (due to which) there comes upon you that (torment) that befell the people of Nuh (Noah), or the people of Hud, or the people of Salih. And (the days of) the people of Lut (Lot) have not anyway passed far before you.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوۡبُوۡۤا اِلَيۡهِ‌ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّىۡ رَحِيۡمٌ وَّدُوۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And seek forgiveness from your Lord, then turn to Him in repentance (with true hearts). Indeed my Lord is Ever-Merciful, Most Loving.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا يٰشُعَيۡبُ مَا نَفۡقَهُ كَثِيۡرًا مِّمَّا تَقُوۡلُ وَاِنَّا لَـنَرٰٮكَ فِيۡنَا ضَعِيۡفًا‌ۚ وَّلَوۡلَا رَهۡطُكَ لَرَجَمۡنٰكَ‌ وَمَاۤ اَنۡتَ عَلَيۡنَا بِعَزِيۡزٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘O Shu‘aib, we do not understand most of your talks, and we know you as a weak person in society. And were it not for your family, we would stone you. (This is what we are conceding for, otherwise) you enjoy no respect in our eyes.’

Words.MeaningEn: surely we would have stoned you

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَرَهۡطِىۡۤ اَعَزُّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِؕ وَاتَّخَذۡتُمُوۡهُ وَرَآءَكُمۡ ظِهۡرِيًّا‌ؕ اِنَّ رَبِّىۡ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ مُحِيۡطٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Shu‘aib said: ‘O my people, is my family more venerable to you than Allah? And you have (as if) cast Him (Allah) behind your backs. Surely, my Lord has encompassed (all) your works.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيٰقَوۡمِ اعۡمَلُوۡا عَلٰى مَكَانَتِكُمۡ اِنِّىۡ عَامِلٌ‌ؕ سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ مَنۡ يَّاۡتِيۡهِ عَذَابٌ يُّخۡزِيۡهِ وَمَنۡ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ‌ؕ وَارۡتَقِبُوۡۤا اِنِّىۡ مَعَكُمۡ رَقِيۡبٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, O my people, keep working in your place; I am doing my work. Soon will you come to know whom that torment seizes which will humiliate him, and who it is that is a liar. And wait on and I (too) wait along with you.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا نَجَّيۡنَا شُعَيۡبًا وَّالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مَعَهٗ بِرَحۡمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَاَخَذَتِ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا الصَّيۡحَةُ فَاَصۡبَحُوۡا فِىۡ دِيَارِهِمۡ جٰثِمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when Our command (of torment) came We saved Shu‘aib and the believers with him through Our Mercy but a dreadful Blast seized the wrongdoers. So they reached the morning (as dead) lying prostrate in their homes —

Verses.VerseAr: كَاَنۡ لَّمۡ يَغۡنَوۡا فِيۡهَا‌ؕ اَلَا بُعۡدًا لِّمَدۡيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتۡ ثَمُوۡدُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: As if they had never put up there. Listen! (The people of) Madyan are doomed as were doomed (the people of) Thamud.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰى بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We sent Musa (Moses, too) with Our Signs and a clear proof,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلٰى فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَاِ۟ ٮِٕهٖ فَاتَّبَعُوۡۤا اَمۡرَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ‌ۚ وَمَاۤ اَمۡرُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِرَشِيۡدٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: To Pharaoh and his chiefs. The chiefs of the people obeyed the command of Pharaoh, although Pharaoh’s command was not right.

Verses.VerseAr: يَقۡدُمُ قَوۡمَهٗ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فَاَوۡرَدَهُمُ النَّارَ‌ؕ وَبِئۡسَ الۡوِرۡدُ الۡمَوۡرُوۡدُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: On the Day of Resurrection he will lead his people and will ultimately bring them down into the Fire of Hell. And how evil that place is to be ushered into!

Verses.VerseAr: وَاُتۡبِعُوۡا فِىۡ هٰذِهٖ لَـعۡنَةً وَّيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ‌ؕ بِئۡسَ الرِّفۡدُ الۡمَرۡفُوۡدُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The curse has been made to chase them in this world and (this will chase them) on the Day of Resurrection (as well). What an evil gift has been bestowed upon them!

Verses.VerseAr: ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ اَنۡۢبَآءِ الۡقُرٰى نَقُصُّهٗ عَلَيۡكَ‌ مِنۡهَا قَآٮِٕمٌ وَّحَصِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Glorious Messenger!) That is some of the news We are relating to you of (those) towns some of which still exist and (some) were totally annihilated.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنٰهُمۡ وَلٰـكِنۡ ظَلَمُوۡۤا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ‌ فَمَاۤ اَغۡنَتۡ عَنۡهُمۡ اٰلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِىۡ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ شَىۡءٍ لَّمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُ رَبِّكَؕ‌ وَمَا زَادُوۡهُمۡ غَيۡرَ تَتۡبِيۡبٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We did not wrong them but they (themselves) wronged their souls. So, their false gods whom they worshipped besides Allah proved to them of no help when the command (of torment) of your Lord came forth. And those (gods) could add only to their destruction and devastation.

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَخۡذُ رَبِّكَ اِذَاۤ اَخَذَ الۡقُرٰى وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ‌ ؕ اِنَّ اَخۡذَهٗۤ اَلِيۡمٌ شَدِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that is how your Lord grips: He seizes the communities when they (become) tyrannous and corrupt. Surely His grip is agonizing and fierce.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً لِّمَنۡ خَافَ عَذَابَ الۡاٰخِرَةِ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ يَوۡمٌ مَّجۡمُوۡعٌ ۙ لَّهُ النَّاسُ وَذٰلِكَ يَوۡمٌ مَّشۡهُوۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed these (episodes) contain lessons of warning for him who fears the chastisement of the Last Day. This (Day of Rising) is the Day when entire mankind will be gathered together and it is this Day when all will be made present.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهٗۤ اِلَّا لِاَجَلٍ مَّعۡدُوۡدٍؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We are not deferring it but for an appointed term (which has already been fixed).

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ يَاۡتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفۡسٌ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِهٖ‌ۚ فَمِنۡهُمۡ شَقِىٌّ وَّسَعِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When that Day comes, not a soul will be able to speak without His permission. Then some of them will be unfortunate and others fortunate.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ شَقُوۡا فَفِىۡ النَّارِ لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا زَفِيۡرٌ وَّشَهِيۡقٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So those who will be unfortunate will be (put) into Hell; there they will be given to screaming and wailing.

Verses.VerseAr: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ‌ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيۡدُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will abide in it till the heavens and the earth (which will then exist) last except as your Lord wills. Surely your Lord executes what He wills.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ سُعِدُوۡا فَفِىۡ الۡجَـنَّةِ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ‌ؕ عَطَآءً غَيۡرَ مَجۡذُوۡذٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who will be fortunate will be in Paradise. They will abide in it forever till the heavens and the earth (which will then exist) endure except as your Lord wills. This is a bounty which will never be withdrawn.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَا تَكُ فِىۡ مِرۡيَةٍ مِّمَّا يَعۡبُدُ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ‌ؕ مَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ اِلَّا كَمَا يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلُ‌ؕ وَاِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوۡهُمۡ نَصِيۡبَهُمۡ غَيۡرَ مَنۡقُوۡصٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, (O listener,) do not have any doubt at all about those which they worship. They do not worship (on the basis of any reason or insight), but (they worship only) as their ancestors have done contiguously before. And certainly We will pay them their full share (of torment) which will not be diminished in the least.

Words.MeaningEn: will surely pay them in full

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَى الۡكِتٰبَ فَاخۡتُلِفَ فِيۡهِ‌ؕ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتۡ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ‌ؕ وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَفِىۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيۡبٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We gave Musa (Moses) the Book. Then differences arose concerning it. And had there not been a decree from your Lord gone forth before, the judgment between them would surely have been passed. And they are certainly caught in a disquieting doubt about it (the Qur’an).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّ كُلاًّ لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمۡ رَبُّكَ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ خَبِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Your Lord will doubtlessly pay them in full for their works. He is certainly Well Aware of whatever they are doing.

Words.MeaningEn: surely will pay them in full

Verses.VerseAr: فَاسۡتَقِمۡ كَمَاۤ اُمِرۡتَ وَمَنۡ تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡا‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ بَصِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So remain firm-footed as you have been commanded, and he too (must persevere) who has turned (to Allah) in your companionship. And, (O people,) do not revolt. Indeed He monitors whatever you do.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا تَرۡكَنُوۡۤا اِلَى الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُۙ وَمَا لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ اَوۡلِيَآءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنۡصَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And incline not towards those who are engaged in oppression (and exploitation) lest the Fire (of Hell) should touch down at you and there will be no protector for you apart from Allah; then help (too) will not be extended to you.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ طَرَفَىِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِّنَ الَّيۡلِ‌ؕ اِنَّ الۡحَسَنٰتِ يُذۡهِبۡنَ السَّيِّاٰتِ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ ذِكۡرٰى لِلذّٰكِرِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And establish Prayer at the two ends of the day and in some parts of the night. Surely good actions delete the evil ones. This is admonition for those who accept admonition.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاصۡبِرۡ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُضِيۡعُ اَجۡرَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And be steadfast. Surely Allah does not let the reward of the pious go to waste.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَوۡلَا كَانَ مِنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكُمۡ اُولُوۡا بَقِيَّةٍ يَّـنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ الۡفَسَادِ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلاً مِّمَّنۡ اَنۡجَيۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ‌ۚ وَاتَّبَعَ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مَاۤ اُتۡرِفُوۡا فِيۡهِ وَكَانُوۡا مُجۡرِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So why were there not among the communities that preceded you men of superior morality and wisdom who would stop people from mischief-mongering in the land, except a few of them whom We delivered? And the unjust stuck to (the same path of) luxury and lustfulness that they were addicted to. And they were (regular) criminals.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهۡلِكَ الۡقُرٰى بِظُلۡمٍ وَّاَهۡلُهَا مُصۡلِحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And your Lord is not such that He would destroy the towns wrongfully while their dwellers are pious.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَـعَلَ النَّاسَ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً‌ وَّلَا يَزَالُوۡنَ مُخۡتَلِفِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And had your Lord so willed, He would have made mankind one Umma (Community. But He has not done so by force. On the contrary He has given free choice to all to adopt a religion.) And (now) these people will always hold divergent views,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا مَنۡ رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَ‌ؕ وَلِذٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمۡ‌ؕ وَتَمَّتۡ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَاَمۡلَـئَنَّ جَهَـنَّمَ مِنَ الۡجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except for him on whom your Lord has bestowed His Mercy and that is what He has created them for. And the Word of your Lord has been fulfilled: ‘Surely I will fill Hell with all the (disbelieving) jinn and men.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَكُلاًّ نَّقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ اَنۡۢبَآءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهٖ فُؤَادَكَ‌ۚ وَجَآءَكَ فِىۡ هٰذِهِ الۡحَـقُّ وَمَوۡعِظَةٌ وَّذِكۡرٰى لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We are relating to you all the news of the Messengers whereby We strengthen your (most purified) heart. And in this (chapter) there has come to you the Truth and Advice and a lesson of warning (and also a reminder) for the believers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقُل لِّـلَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ اعۡمَلُوۡا عَلٰى مَكَانَتِكُمۡؕ اِنَّا عٰمِلُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And say to those who do not believe: ‘Work on in your place and we are doing (what our station demands).

Verses.VerseAr: وَانْـتَظِرُوۡا‌ۚ اِنَّا مُنۡتَظِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And wait on; we (too) are waiting.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلِلّٰهِ غَيۡبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَاِلَيۡهِ يُرۡجَعُ الۡاَمۡرُ كُلُّهٗ فَاعۡبُدۡهُ وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَيۡهِ‌ؕ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (all) the unseen of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah alone and He is the One towards Whom every act is returned. So keep worshipping Him and keep trust in Him alone. And your Lord is not unmindful of the deeds that all of you do.
